```lean
intro n
have h1 : 0 < Real.pi * τ.im := mul_pos (zero_lt_real_pi) hτ
let a := Real.pi * Complex.I * ↑n ^ 2 * τ
have h2 : 0 < a.re := by
  have h3 : 0 < Real.pi * τ.im := h1
  rw [Complex.re] at h3
  simp only [Real.pi, Complex.I, Complex.re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Real.ofReal, Real.mul]
  exact h3
have h4 : Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs = Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im * n.natAbs) :=
  by rw [Real.pow_exp, Real.mul_assoc, Real.pow_mul, Real.exp_mul]
have h5 : ‖Complex.exp a‖ = Real.exp (Real.re a) :=
  by rw [Complex.nnnorm_eq_real_exp_re]
have h6 : Real.re a = Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n ^ 2 :=
  by rw [Complex.re, Real.pi, Complex.I, Complex.re, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im, Real.ofReal, Real.mul]
have h7 : Real.exp (Real.re a) = Real.exp (Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n ^ 2) :=
  by rw h6
have h8 : Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n ^ 2 ≤ Real.pi * τ.im * n.natAbs :=
  by rw [Real.mul_le_mul_left (Real.ofNat_nonneg _), Real.le_abs]
  exact le_rfl
have h9 : Real.exp (Real.pi * τ.im * ↑n ^ 2) ≤ Real.exp (Real.pi * τ.im * n.natAbs) :=
  by rw [h4, Real.exp_le_exp]; exact h8
have h10 : ‖Complex.exp a‖ ≤ Real.exp (-Real.pi * τ.im) ^ n.natAbs :=
  by rw [h5, h7, h9]
exact h10
```
